climate.overview_html: COP31 in Antalya ran past its Friday close with no deal on the cover decision; the presidency promised a third draft on Saturday morning. A bloc of 23 countries, including the EU, wants fossil fuel transition language restored after the second draft dropped it. A voluntary electrification package sits outside the negotiated text.

items.headline: COP31 talks go into overtime as nations row over fossil fuels
items.summary: Negotiators worked overnight after the Friday deadline passed, with a third draft of the cover decision due at 9 a.m. Saturday. COP31 president Murat Kurum told the plenary the parties were close but not finished.

items.headline: Activists and leaders criticise COP31 draft that omits fossil fuels
items.summary: The second draft removed references to transitioning away from fossil fuels and dropped a proposed $120 billion adaptation finance target. Panama and about a dozen other countries signed a letter demanding the transition language return.

items.headline: COP31 hosts back a voluntary electrification package
items.summary: The COP31 Electrification Delivery Package groups pledges to replace direct fossil fuel use with electric alternatives. It is voluntary and not part of the negotiated cover text.

major_events.name: Cyclone Akvan remnants, Odisha, India
major_events.status: Weakened to low pressure, heavy rain
major_events.impact: Akvan crossed the coast near Gopalpur on Nov 20 and weakened to a depression, then a low. Odisha reports no major damage or deaths; about 3.7 lakh people were evacuated. IMD kept an orange alert for 14 districts with 12-20 cm of rain possible.

major_events.name: Cyclone Xavier, South Pacific
major_events.impact: Samoa Meteorological Service said Xavier weakened to Category 1 about 920 km northeast of Apia and the chance of direct impacts in the next 12-24 hours is low. The Northern Cook Islands took the brunt earlier in the week.

major_events.name: Thanksgiving-week storms, US coasts
major_events.impact: Weather.com expects a Southeast low to track into the mid-Atlantic on Wednesday and a possible major Northeast storm on Thursday. Two wet, windy systems are forecast for northern California to Washington on Tuesday and Wednesday. NHC gives a low off Florida a 60% chance of subtropical or tropical development in 7 days.

major_events.name: Heatwave, Cape York, Australia
major_events.impact: BoM kept a severe heatwave warning for the Peninsula with highs in the high 30s to near 40°C. Weipa's run above 36°C passed 41 days, its longest on record.

weather.overview_html: Cyclone Akvan caused no major damage in Odisha and has weakened to a low, though heavy rain alerts remain. Forecasters see storms on both US coasts during Thanksgiving week, and NHC is watching a low off Florida for subtropical development. Indonesia's BNPB warned of floods and landslides across Central Java, Aceh and Papua.

items.headline: Odisha reports no major damage or deaths from Cyclone Akvan
items.summary: Disaster management minister Suresh Pujari said no major damage or loss of life was reported after landfall near Gopalpur. The state deployed 423 rescue teams and opened 9,341 shelters.

items.headline: Akvan's remnant weakens into a low over central Odisha
items.summary: Wind speeds have dropped sharply as the system moves inland. IMD expects rainfall to ease from Saturday.

items.headline: Storms on both US coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
items.summary: Models increasingly show a Wednesday storm from the Southeast into the mid-Atlantic and a possible major Northeast storm on Thanksgiving Day. Two systems are forecast for the Pacific Northwest and northern California on Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.headline: NHC gives a low off Florida a 60% chance of development
items.summary: The National Hurricane Center rates the system's chance of becoming a tropical or subtropical cyclone within seven days at 60%. A November landfall would be rare.

items.headline: Wasatch Mountains get a winter storm warning through Saturday morning
items.summary: The warning runs until 11 a.m. MST on Nov 21. An earlier version called for 12-24 inches of total snow, highest in the Upper Cottonwoods.

items.headline: Indonesia warns of floods and landslides in Central Java, Aceh and Papua
items.summary: BNPB flagged moderate to very heavy rain for Saturday, naming Pati, Blora, Demak, Kudus and Semarang among vulnerable areas. BMKG says hazardous conditions could last until Nov 26.

items.headline: Severe heatwave warning stays in place for Cape York
items.summary: The Bureau of Meteorology forecast highs in the high 30s to near 40°C before easing later in the week. Weipa set a November record of 39.9°C on Nov 10.

renewables.overview_html: The US administration is reviewing a key permit for EDF's 2.8 GW Atlantic Shores South project. Solcast data show October irradiance more than 20% above average across southern China and Southeast Asia. The Philippines signed an offshore wind deal with Ming Yang.

items.headline: Atlantic Shores South faces a new federal permit review
items.summary: The administration is re-examining a key permit for EDF's stalled 2.8 GW project off New Jersey. The review adds to delays for US East Coast offshore wind.

items.headline: October irradiance ran over 20% above average in Southeast Asia
items.summary: Solcast attributes the gains in southern China and Southeast Asia to strong El Niño conditions, persistent high pressure and less cloud. Sichuan came in below average.

items.headline: Philippines signs offshore wind agreement with China's Ming Yang
items.summary: President Marcos signed the agreement to build out offshore wind infrastructure and cut reliance on imported fuel.

science.overview_html: A review led by Messori compares data-driven and physics-based forecasts of extremes and finds hybrid systems show some of the largest gains. A NeurIPS workshop paper probes GraphCast with sparse autoencoders and finds a feature tied to the model's mesh affects geopotential skill. It was a thin week for new results in the window this run could reach.

items.headline: Review compares data-driven and NWP forecasts of extreme weather
items.summary: The review surveys how ML and physics-based models handle extremes and finds hybrid systems that combine the two show some of the largest gains.

items.headline: Sparse autoencoder audit finds GraphCast relies on mesh-locked features
items.summary: Ablating a feature tied to GraphCast's computational mesh raised global geopotential height error despite no physical meaning. The authors argue physical interpretability and causal usefulness are separable (NeurIPS 2026 page).

items.title: Meteomatics opens a weather drone base at McAlester airport in Oklahoma
items.body_html: Meteomatics will run its second operational Meteobase at McAlester Regional Airport, the first at an active US airport. It flies under the NOAA National Mesonet Program, managed by KBR with Synoptic Data as lead subcontractor, and feeds boundary-layer profiles into Meteomatics' US1k model.

items.title: ECMWF and partners win two HPCwire awards for AI forecasting
items.body_html: ECMWF and European met services won Best Use of HPC/AI in Physical Sciences for operational AI models, and Forecast-in-a-Box won the societal response category. Forecast-in-a-Box packages ECMWF and Anemoi software so public institutions can run AI forecasts on their own hardware.

items.title: Parallel Works wins an HPCwire award for moving NOAA forecast workloads to the cloud
items.body_html: Parallel Works took the Editors’ Choice award for Best Use of HPC in the Cloud at SC26 for running mission-critical weather forecasting in the cloud. Its software moves NOAA workflows, including RRFS development, between supercomputers and commercial clouds.

items.title: ECMWF details free forecast data for WMO members under Early Warnings for All
items.body_html: ECMWF set out its support for national met services, centred on the WMO Support Dataset. The free regional feed gives fields to initialise limited-area models such as WRF and ICON, for official use only, and cannot be redistributed.
